description: Thicken a graph (polylines — Skeleton branches, smoothed graphs, canvas Graphs) into ONE seamless constant-width PATH band (closed Space polygons) of Width metres — the Skeleton node's Make-path as its own reusable node. Clip to boundary trims the band to the source space. With the Flow Live toggle ON the band materialises as a real editable Space; Run Flow commits it as a Corridor Space.
instructions:
Takes a GRAPH input (polylines — e.g. Skeleton in Branches mode, Graph Smoothing, a canvas Graph source) and thickens every edge to a `width`-metre band, mitred flush at shared junctions and unioned into ONE seamless closed path polygon — the exact corridor machinery the Skeleton node's Make-path uses. `clipToBoundary` trims the band to the upstream Skeleton's source Space (or the `gin-boundary` clip Space when wired). One output handle per band, or a single bundle (`outputMode`). Every parameter is wireable (valin-*).

With the Flow Live toggle ON the band materialises as a REAL editable Space that tracks the params; Run Flow commits it as a Corridor-region Space. Idiom: Space → Skeleton (Branches, prune / longest branch as needed) → Graph to Path (width) — the decoupled Make-path.
